doc.name: shipnote
doc.instructions: ShipNote prints, stamps and mails real postcards to US addresses. list_card_designs shows the designs, quote_price gives a price, and create_draft saves a draft: for one person (a single thank-you postcard, one recipient) or for a whole registry or guest list. Nothing is mailed or charged from chat; the sender adds their return address, reviews the cards and pays on shipnote.co.

tools.name: list_card_designs
tools.title: Browse card designs
tools.description: List the occasions ShipNote makes postcards for, and the card designs available for one occasion, each with the id that create_draft accepts as design. Read-only: it saves nothing.

occasion.description: Occasion id from this tool's occasion list, e.g. wedding, baby-shower, thank-you. Without it, the tool returns the list of occasions.

tools.name: quote_price
tools.title: Get a price quote
tools.description: Price for printing, stamping and mailing a number of ShipNote postcards within the US. Read-only: it saves nothing and charges nothing.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.title: Save cards as a draft
tools.description: Save a DRAFT of postcards, from a single card to one person (e.g. "send a thank-you postcard to my aunt") to a whole registry or guest list, and return a link where the sender adds their return address, reviews every card, and pays on shipnote.co. This tool never mails a card and never charges anyone. Each recipient is one card (one per household for a list): the name as it appears on the card, the full US mailing address as "Street, City, ST ZIP" (empty if unknown), and the gift as a short noun phrase without the store name (e.g. "stand mixer", not "KitchenAid stand mixer from Target"). senderName is the name the sender signs cards with; without it, the default message stays unsigned until the sender fills it in on shipnote.co. Up to 500 recipients per draft. Each call makes a new draft with a new link. This tool can't take a picture. A photo card (the sender's own picture as the whole front) is saved with design image-only, and the sender adds the photo on shipnote.co after opening the link; a photo inside a design uses a design marked (1 photo). list_card_designs also shows designs that need no photo.

design.description: A design id from list_card_designs for that occasion.

message.description: The card message, with [RECIPIENT] and [GIFT_NAME] as placeholders ShipNote fills in for each card. Defaults to the occasion's standard message.

senderName.description: How the sender signs, e.g. "Sam & Alex". Replaces [YOUR NAME] and becomes the return-address name.
